subject: POC follow-up: add 'returns triage' workflow and rebaseline success metrics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@retailco.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC follow-up: proposed success metrics & next steps

Hi Samantha —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we spin up the trial: 

Scope (as discussed on call)
- Primary: search-augmented chat for product discovery across web + catalog
- Secondary: product recommendations for homepage personalization

Initial POC proposal (staging): 2 weeks, using a 50k-item sample catalog + anonymized session traces you provided in demo. Redwood will provide a dedicated staging endpoint and an evaluation harness for relevance/latency measurement.

Proposed success criteria (baseline)
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 600ms (staging)
- Relevance: top-3 precision >= 0.72 on your internal relevance set
- Operational: < 1% error rate for inference calls
- Cost signal: projected inference cost <= $0.45 / 1k tokens for 8k context profiles

Deliverables from Redwood
- Staging endpoint + API keys
- Eval harness and dashboards (shared Drive link)
- Weekly check-in and a final result pack (metrics + sample traces)

Action items for RetailCo
- Share sample dataset + prioritized use-case checklist (by Tue 07/22)
- Confirm who will own evaluation and who is the integration lead

Attachments: redwood_poc_eval_plan_v1.xlsx (evaluation plan + metrics), slo_matrix_returns_tranche.csv (initial SLOs)

If you want to add additional flows to the trial we can rebaseline — happy to propose a short extension. Proposed time for kickoff: Wed 07/23 10am PT — does that work?

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172


From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@retailco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ProductOps Team <productops@retailco.com>, RetailCo DevOps <devops@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: proposed success metrics & next steps

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and aligns with most of what we spoke about. Two quick items we need to add that are blocking for our stakeholders: 

1) Add 'returns triage' workflow as a third use case in the POC. High-level ask:
   - Automatically classify incoming returns and route to the correct queue (fraud, refund, replacement)
   - Business KPIs: reduce manual routing volume by 40% and time-to-first-response to < 3 minutes for triaged cases

2) Evaluation owner & timeline: we need RetailCo to own the business acceptance criteria and provide sample logs. Who on your side will be the integration lead and who will validate the KPIs? If adding returns is going to require extra infra or a longer window, that'll be fine as long as we have the new timeline.

We can run a 3-week window if needed; please propose updated success criteria and owners. Also, attaching a sanitized snippet of our returns log for your intake (sample_returns_log.csv).

—Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Product Operations, RetailCo
 s.lee@retailco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@retailco.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: proposed success metrics & next steps

Appreciate the quick follow-up, Sam — adding returns triage makes sense and is something we've enabled for other retail customers. Suggested rebaseline below: 

Revised POC proposal (staging): 3 weeks total to accommodate integration and additional evaluation suite.

Updated success criteria (adds returns-specific metrics):
- Search/chat & recs (same as baseline): latency p95 < 600ms; top-3 precision >= 0.72
- Returns triage (new): classification precision >= 0.80 on historical labels; reduce manual routing by >= 35% (measured vs. 2-week pre-trial baseline)
- Operational: sustained error rate < 1.5% with the additional workflow
- Business response SLA: time-to-first-response for triaged returns < 3 minutes median

Proposed owners / responsibilities:
- RetailCo integration & data: RetailCo ProductOps (Samantha / ProductOps) — provide sample logs, SLA for data delivery
- Redwood integration lead: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com) — integration, ingestion, staging config
- Redwood evaluation lead: Lauren Bishop (lauren.bishop@redwood.com) — eval harness, dashboarding, metric calc
- Commercial & escalation: Ben Carter — contract, scope changes, weekly cadence

Impact on timeline and infra:
- We'll provision a separate returns-triage model variant and a slightly larger staging instance to keep p95 latency targets — this increases staging allocation and adds a small infra delta. Monica, can you review the staging sizing notes and confirm?

Attached: redwood_poc_eval_plan_v2.xlsx (updated metrics + timeline), sla_matrix_returns_tranche.csv (detailed SLOs)

If that looks good, we can schedule a kickoff on Thu 07/24 to walk through ingestion (RetailCo to confirm earliest time slot).

Thanks —
Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <s.lee@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: proposed success metrics & next steps

Looping in a few technical notes from our infra side so RetailCo and internal teams have expectations before kickoff: 

- Data ingestion: returns logs look good from the sample. We'll need a flattened CSV with columns: request_id, customer_id (anonymized), item_sku, reason_text, timestamp, previous_queue. Sam — can you confirm you can provide that by Thu 07/24 9am PT?

- Model variant: returns triage uses a classification head on top of our encoder; it will add ~10% memory to the runtime KV footprint for the staging instance. I recommend staging with 1x large GPU instead of the default 1x medium for the first week, then scale down if metrics hold.

- Evaluation: Lauren will wire the classification eval to your labeled subset and run cross-validation; note that the precision target of 0.80 is achievable with a small amount of label noise but we'll surface per-class performance.

- Security/compliance: since returns logs include PII-like identifiers, we should confirm retention policy. Stephanie, can you confirm Redwood's default staging retention (30 days) and whether RetailCo needs shorter retention?

I'll take primary ownership on integration and will post a short tech-runbook before the kickoff. If you want, I can also provision a short smoke test script to validate ingestion.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0128

Subject: Re: POC follow-up: proposed success metrics & next steps

Thanks all — RetailCo confirms the updated plan. We can provide the flattened returns CSV by Thu 08/06 9am PT (we had to sanitize a few fields). The 3-week window is acceptable. Confirming the kickoff on Thu 07/24 is no longer possible on our side (apologies) — proposed new kickoff: Mon 08/10 10am PT. If Redwood can hold the staging environment until then, we accept your owners and the revised criteria.

Quick notes: 
- We'll measure manual routing reduction against a 2-week pre-trial sample (we'll share the baseline metrics).
- Please include a short section in the final deliverable that explains false-positive handling for returns triage — our Ops team wants a clear rollback path.

Attachments: sample_returns_log.csv (sanitized snippet)

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Sam
